_comment: Muse Glimmer 30B on xolotl-glimmer (docs/GLIMMER.md): 512K context with q8 K/V on a 24 GB card, pictures on the CPU encoder. Edit the paths.
_vision: pictures on the CPU (~13 s each, 391 rows for 640x480): at 512K the engine + the f16 mmproj on the GPU (4.3 GB) leave no room for a long prefill (measured 13 Nov: 23.8 GB idle, 8K prefill failed). For a smaller --context set vision.gpu true.
